description: Near-black ClearScaler lead workspace over a faint grid of dark isometric cubes: contact panel 'Sofia Berglund, Head of Growth' and an email draft ('Subject: Last year's lanes') rewritten live, with the old line struck through and personalised lines typing in, ending on an orange 'Approve & send' button. White caption 'Written per person.' with orange accent. Dark charcoal, white and orange.

Square crop on the ClearScaler email draft card: dark charcoal panel with orange-edged source chips ('Hiring two pricing analysts', 'Rates page unchanged'), white text typing, strikethrough rewrite, ending on an orange 'Approve & send' button.

Warm blush/peach background. A Creoble-built 'Cafe Salvie' website mockup scrolls (menu cards, dark green coffee-cup photo, latte-art photo) beside a floating white price card 'DIN HJEMMESIDE 499 kr' in large rust-brown serif, with ticks appearing for 'En betaling' and 'Intet abonnement'. Cream, peach, rust and coffee tones.
Vertical crop on the white '499 kr' price card (large rust-brown serif numerals, check ticks appearing) on a peach background. The card's sides bleed slightly off the frame edges.

Pink florist website 'Blomsterhuset Rosa' with a big serif headline 'Blomster, bundet med kaerlighed' (rose italic accent), raspberry buttons and colourful bouquet photos, plus a chatbot panel with a raspberry header where a Danish conversation types out (same-day delivery question, then bridal bouquet price). Blush pink, raspberry, hydrangea blue and orange flowers.

Square crop on the Blomsterhuset Rosa chatbot: raspberry header, cream bot bubbles and dark user bubbles filling up, with hydrangea and flower photos at the edges and a hand cursor. Pink, raspberry, blue flowers.

White card on a light grey background: process pills 'Outreach > Follow-ups > Approvals > CRM updates' over a blurred office photo of people pointing at a laptop. Red 'Friction' tags; the heading changes Diagnose > Build > Run as the pills get navy checkmarks and cursors labelled 'K.B' and 'Your team' (cyan) click through. White, navy, red and cyan accents.

Real Malaga holiday-rental bedroom (warm wood, white bed) with a white 'Rental management' checklist card (Reservations, Guest arrivals, Cleaning, Maintenance, all green ticks) and a terracotta-orange house photo card 'Your home - Malaga'. Badges show 'Ready for guests', date chips 12-19 Jul / 20-27 Jul / 2-9 Aug, then 'Renting out' toggles off to 'Not rented'. Terracotta, warm wood, white and green.

Vertical crop on the terracotta-orange house photo card ('Your home - Malaga', 'Ready for guests' badge, then 'Renting out' toggle and 'Not rented') over the warm hotel bedroom, with date chips below.

Pale icy-blue background. White card '18 months later, K.B Consultancy valuation' with a huge navy counter rolling up from about EUR 1,400,000 to EUR 2,000,000 and a green line 'From founding to EUR 2M in 18 months'. A post card from Robin Bos slides in with a quote and a photo of four people holding silver '2M' balloons. Light blue, white and navy.

Sunlit photo of a woman relaxing in a bubbling outdoor spa among green palm leaves and sparkling turquoise water. A frosted white 'Your spa' card fades in, its teal ring gauge counts 31 to 38 degrees, then a 'Ready' tick appears, with season tabs below. Green, turquoise, white and teal.
Vertical crop on the 'Your spa' card (teal ring counting 31 to 38 degrees, 'Ready' tick) over blurred palm leaves and sparkling spa water. The card's sides bleed slightly off the frame edges.
Square crop: the woman's shoulders in the spa, green palm fronds and glittering turquoise water, with the frosted 'Your spa' card and teal temperature ring counting up to 38 degrees, then 'Ready'.

Pale mint/sage background, teal Voxflow script logo + bold 'werkt'. Kinetic dark-teal words swap: 'professioneel,' then 'snel,' then 'zonder pauzes.' (struck through). Also a teal chat bubble 'Goedemiddag, waarmee kan ik je helpen?', a '<3 sec' ring and weekday dots. At right, a photo card of a smiling woman on a red phone (tag 'Beller'). Mint, deep teal and red.
Vertical crop on the caller photo card: a smiling woman holding a red phone, 'Beller' tag, rounded card drifting gently on a pale mint background.

Light blue-grey isometric illustration: a black 'Your business' cube inside a blue rounded loop, a blue market grid, a mint CRM building and a beige team platform with figures. A 'Found a company that fits' notification appears, then an email card typing 'Hi Anna, I saw you're hiring two salespeople...' with blue highlights and an 'Approved' badge. The caption 'Finding the right prospects, writing personalized outreach.' changes to 'Automating'. Blue, black, mint and beige.

White dotted canvas with soft lavender/blue and pale yellow gradient glows. WKC and bfound logo tiles are linked by a thin arc. A big bold indigo 'BFOUND50' referral-code field with a blue check; text builds '50% off our startup price' and a large black 'EUR 400 WKConversions startup price'. White, indigo/periwinkle and black.
